definitions.gloss: small number of people, small group
definitions.explanation: Refers to a small group or a limited number of participants. Commonly used in educational and business contexts to describe small-group settings.

examples.japanese: {少人数|しょうにんずう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
{少人数|しょうにんずう}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧しやすい。
examples.english: It's easier to ask questions in small-group lessons.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{少人数|しょうにんずう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{一人一人|ひとりひとり}→一人一人：03711_hitorihitori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: This training session will be conducted with a small group, so each person will receive individual attention.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used as a modifier: {少人数|しょうにんずう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～ or {少人数|しょうにんずう}～. The opposite is ⟦{大人数|おおにんずう}→大人数：22750_ooninzuu⟧ (large number of people). Very common in education ({少人数|しょうにんずう}⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧, small-group education) and business contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {少人数|しょうにんずう}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧: small-group system
- {少人数|しょうにんずう}⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧: small-group education
- {少人数|しょうにんずう}⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧: small class
- {少人数|しょうにんずう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: conduct with a small group
